profile.name: 可调谐飞秒激光器
profile.description: 这是一类可调谐输出波长的超快飞秒激光器，通常带有快门、对准模式以及色散补偿相关设置（如 GDD）。它常用于双光子显微、非线性光学实验、超快光谱和需要可调近红外激发光源的科研场景。
profile.description_en: This is a tunable ultrafast femtosecond laser with adjustable output wavelength, typically including a shutter, alignment mode, and dispersion-compensation controls such as GDD. It is commonly used in two-photon microscopy, nonlinear optics, ultrafast spectroscopy, and other research applications requiring a tunable near-infrared excitation source.
